evidence.limitation: Does not date the entire affiliation interval or establish every book as gender history.

claims.subject: work:scott_gender_2010

evidence.support: Scott retains gender as critical analysis when it questions how sex categories acquire meaning.
evidence.limitation: Abstract only; not evidence of subsequent uptake or full argument.

review.rationale: Evidence inspected for this bounded research batch; production acceptance and broader interpretation remain pending.

claims.qualification: Renewal of a critical question rather than proof of a new school founded in 2010.

claims.subject: work:scott_secularism_2017

evidence.support: Scott explicitly identifies a genealogical inquiry into changing uses of secularism and challenges an inevitable progress toward gender equality.
evidence.limitation: Selected introduction passages only; author’s programme, not independent proof of its historical generalizations.

review.rationale: Evidence inspected for this bounded research batch; production acceptance and broader interpretation remain pending.

claims.qualification: A method explicitly described by Scott; the broader critique and reception require separately represented claims.
